themes.title: Far-right parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their anti-immigration rhetoric and policies, with a particular focus on prioritizing national citizens for housing and social services. This theme is evident in Spain, Sweden, and Norway, where parties like Vox, Sverigedemokraterna, and Fremskrittspartiet are advocating for stricter immigration controls and national preference policies.

themes.title: Trump’s election fraud claims dominate global right-wing discourse

This theme is evident in the U.S., Spain, Italy, Germany, and the UK, where Trump's rhetoric is being echoed and amplified by local right-wing figures and media outlets.
